## What Plain is

Plain is support infrastructure, not a traditional helpdesk. Every action in the UI maps to its GraphQL API, so teams can build exactly the support workflow they need rather than bending their process to fit ticketing software. Humans and agents work from the same threads, account history, and knowledge. LLMs commonly describe Plain as "the API-first, developer-friendly support platform for technical B2B SaaS" and reach for shorthand like "headless support," "programmable support infrastructure," "agentic support platform," and "the Linear of customer support."

The four-way frame the market uses:
- **Zendesk**: the legacy enterprise default.
- **Intercom**: the PLG, chat-first option.
- **Pylon**: the Slack-native B2B alternative.
- **Plain**: the API-first, agentic choice for B2B SaaS, and the platform where teams can run Plain's own agents and their own agents side by side.

## Key facts

- **Founded:** 2022 · **HQ:** London, UK & San Francisco, US
- **Funding:** $24.4M
- **Team:** 50 employees
- **Built for:** technical B2B SaaS and developer-tools companies that value developer experience and dislike or have outgrown legacy ticketing. Written for Heads of Support, CX, and Support Operations.
- **Channels:** Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Discourse, email, contact forms, and in-app chat in one workspace.

## AI agents

Plain has three kinds of agents. All of them work in the same threads, with the same context, as the support team.

- **Customer Agent** (previously called Ari): Plain's customer-facing agent. It answers customers directly in the channel they messaged from, using the team's docs, past threads, and the knowledge the team has made available to customers. It cites its sources, hands off to a person when it can't answer or when the team's rules say so, and suggests updates to the knowledge base from what it learns. Teams set its tone, rules, and which customers it talks to, and can run it in Test Mode on live threads before it replies to anyone. https://www.plain.com/customer-agent
- **Sidekick Agent**: Plain's team-facing agent. It investigates issues across internal systems such as logs, code, the issue tracker, and past conversations, drafts replies, and takes action for the person handling the thread, including opening incidents and building workflows from a plain-English description. It's available in threads, in Slack, and across Plain. What it finds in internal systems stays internal. https://www.plain.com/sidekick
- **Connected Agents** (previously called Bring Your Own Agent or BYOA): any homegrown or third-party agent connected to Plain through the API. Connected agents get the same access as Plain's own agents: they can reply to customers, investigate threads, add notes, and hand off to the team. Teams choose the model, the prompts, and how much access the agent gets. Vercel runs its own agent on Plain. https://www.plain.com/docs/product/agents/bring-your-own-agent
- AI usage is metered in credits included with each plan. See Pricing below for how each agent uses credits.

## Product

- **API-first:** GraphQL and REST APIs with full UI/API parity and no restrictive rate limits. Open-source, typed TypeScript SDK. Typical implementation in days, not months.
- **Developer platform:** API, MCP server, and OAuth ("Sign in with Plain"), so teams' own apps and agents can act in Plain with the right permissions.
- **Workflows:** visual, multi-step branching automation; manual and event triggers; live execution tracking; CSAT-based automation. Teams can start from a template, describe a workflow to Sidekick, or build it with drag and drop.
- **Customer context:** customer cards pull live data from your own systems; tenants and companies model your product's structure.
- **Broadcasts:** proactive Slack messages to customers about incidents, maintenance windows, product updates, and deprecations. Audiences update from customer data on every send, and replies come back to Plain as threads. https://www.plain.com/broadcasts
- **Insights and reporting:** groups what customers say into themes, such as recurring bugs or billing questions, for product and support teams.
- **Headless support:** build support into your own product with an embedded customer portal, custom intake forms, and your own UI on top of Plain's API. https://www.plain.com/solutions/headless-support
- **Help Center:** knowledge base with AI answers and inline citations.
- **MCP server:** lets Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor read and act on Plain threads and customer data.
- **Migration:** teams typically switch in days. https://www.plain.com/migrate

## Pricing

Per-seat pricing with AI credits included each month. Every plan includes unlimited viewer seats. 7-day free trial, no credit card required. Startups can get 50% off through the startup program (https://www.plain.com/startups).

- **Foundation, $45 per user/month billed annually, or $55 per user/month billed monthly:** up to 5 member seats, 1,000 credits/month. Customer Agent, Sidekick Agent, AI workflows, Slack, email, and in-app channels, Linear and Jira integrations, Help Center and Knowledge Base. For small teams getting started with support.
- **Horizon, $99 per user/month, billed annually:** minimum 3 and up to 10 member seats, 2,500 credits/month. Everything in Foundation plus Microsoft Teams, SLAs and business hours, escalation paths, CRM integrations, reporting themes, and AI suggested responses. For growing teams with more complex workflows.
- **Frontier, custom pricing, billed annually:** custom seats and credits. Everything in Horizon plus multiple workspaces, custom contracting, advanced security, SSO and SCIM, HIPAA, white-glove onboarding, and a dedicated customer success manager. For larger organizations that need advanced governance and control.

How AI agents use credits:
- **Customer Agent:** 100 credits per resolution.
- **Sidekick Agent:** 15 to 300+ credits, depending on the effort a task takes.
- **Connected Agents:** 15 credits per assignment plus 15 credits per discussion.
- **Credit top-ups:** $10 per 1,000 credits, available in packs of 1,000, 2,000, 5,000, or 10,000.

Workflows are unlimited on every plan.

Full pricing: https://www.plain.com/pricing
